title: tricks.toml
description: New Tricks configuration: a source repo's manifest (`[source-repo]`, `[skills]`, `[lint]`, `[publish]`) or the user config at ~/.config/newtricks/tricks.toml (`[settings]`, `[catalogs]`, `[source-repos]`). Resolved facts live in tricks.lock. Keep in sync with crates/newtricks/src/config.rs (a unit test checks the keys).

policy.description: How a vendored skill follows its upstream: `review` reports upstream changes and merges them on `tricks update`; `pinned` stays on the recorded base unless the skill is named (`tricks update <skill>`); `paused` stops checking upstream.

agents.description: Agents `link` and `try` deploy for when neither `--agents` nor the source repo's `agents` says otherwise.

fetch_interval.description: Minimum time between fetches of a repository or catalog.

live.description: Live-query catalogs consulted on each search (`--no-live` skips them for one search).

source-repos.description: Registered source repos (user config): name = path. `tricks init` adds entries.

catalogs.description: Search catalogs (user config), keyed by repository, site URL or pointer file. `tricks catalog add` / `remove` edit this table.

name.description: The source repo's name (default: the repository folder name).

agents.description: Agents this repo's skills are linked for (default: the user setting).

skills.description: The source repo's skills, by name.

path.description: Directory of the skill, relative to the repository root.

upstream.description: Vendored skills: the upstream skill id (host/owner/repo//path, or a catalog-hosted id).

track.description: Vendored skills: `latest` (highest semver tag, else the default branch) or a branch name.

use.description: The branch variant links deploy by default (`tricks use <skill>@<branch>`); links pinned to a branch are unaffected.

justification.description: Why publishing this skill is allowed despite the licence gate.

license-override.description: Lets `publish` pass the licence gate for this skill.

ignore.description: Rules not reported for any skill.

strict-spec.description: Frontmatter keys outside the Agent Skills spec are errors, as in the `skills-ref` reference validator (default: info).

targets.description: Distribution repositories `tricks publish <target>` writes to, by name.

repo.description: The distribution repository: owner/repo, host/owner/repo, a git URL, or a path to a repository that accepts pushes.

exclude.description: Globs relative to each skill directory, left out of the published copy.

plugins.description: Optional plugin groups for marketplace.json; ungrouped skills go into the default plugin.

marketplace.description: Marketplace name (kebab-case); defaults to the target repository name.
